skill.summary: Scrapes trending gaming data and viral clips to generate optimized scripts and produce viral gaming videos with AI for content creators and monetization.

latestVersion.changelog:
AI Gaming Content and Monetization Machine v1.0.0

- Initial public release for gaming content automation.
- Scrapes gaming trends from Reddit, TikTok, YouTube, Twitter/X, Steam, and more.
- Analyzes viral video formats, detects emerging topics, and extracts top-performing clips.
- Generates 30 optimized gaming video scripts with hooks and A/B variations.
- Produces short-form 9:16 gaming videos with AI voiceover, captions, and music.
- Builds a full content calendar mapped to game releases, and identifies monetization opportunities.
